origin.origins.arachnid.description: Born of spider blood, Arachnids scale walls with ease and spin webs to ensnare their prey. Their predatory metabolism craves meat, though they can stomach anything in a pinch.
origin.origins.avian.description: Graceful sky-dwellers who thrive at high altitudes. The higher they climb, the faster and more agile they become. Their delicate digestion favors plants and grains over heavy meats.
origin.origins.blazeborn.description: Late descendants of the Blaze, Blazeborn walk through fire and lava unscathed. Their inner flame fuels a kinship with the Nether, but contact with water dampens their power and slows them to a crawl.
origin.origins.enderian.description: Children of the Ender Dragon, Enderians slip between spaces with a thought. Each teleport leaves them surging with void energy, amplifying their strikes. Water is anathema to their nature, draining their strength on contact.
origin.origins.merling.description: Natural inhabitants of the deep, Merlings breathe and thrive beneath the waves. On land they function well enough, but staying dry too long leaves them sluggish and gasping.
origin.origins.phantom.description: Half-human, half-phantom, these spectral beings can phase through solid blocks at will. Their ghostly nature halves their vitality, and direct sunlight saps what remains. Phantoms never truly die — at the brink of death, their form collapses into a weakened spectral state for 5 minutes instead.
origin.origins.shulk.description: Kin to the Shulker, their hardened shell provides natural armor and cushions their equipment against the ravages of death. Powerful arms let them mine faster, though their heavy frames demand more sustenance.
origin.origins.feline.description: Cat-like and nimble, Felines move in silence and always land on their feet. Their natural dexterity is unmatched, but their light frames leave them with 20% less health than sturdier folk.
origin.origins.human.name: Mundane
origin.origins.human.description: An ordinary soul with no innate gifts or curses. The balanced choice for those who prefer to let their Race and Class define them entirely.
power.origins.carnivore.name: Meat Preference
power.origins.carnivore.description: Non-meat foods provide 50% less nourishment. Your predatory metabolism craves protein.
power.origins.vegetarian.name: Plant Preference
power.origins.vegetarian.description: Meat provides 50% less nourishment. Your delicate digestion favors plants and grains.
power.origins.fresh_air.name: Sky Affinity
power.origins.fresh_air.description: You gain speed and agility at high altitudes. Above Y=80: Speed I + Jump Boost I. Above Y=150: enhanced further with Slow Falling.
power.origins.burn_in_daylight.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
power.origins.burn_in_daylight.descripti: Direct sunlight causes Weakness and Slowness. Wear a helmet or stay in shade to avoid the effects.
power.origins.hunger_over_time.name: Restless Hunger
power.origins.hunger_over_time.descripti: Your spectral nature burns energy 25% faster than normal.
power.origins.more_exhaustion.name: Heavy Metabolism
power.origins.more_exhaustion.descriptio: Your armored body requires 25% more fuel than others.
power.origins.water_vulnerability.name: Water Discomfort
power.origins.water_vulnerability.descri: Contact with water slows you and saps your strength.
power.origins.water_breathing.name: Amphibious
power.origins.water_breathing.descriptio: You breathe underwater naturally. On land, you gradually grow sluggish if you stay dry for more than 5 minutes.
power.origins.damage_from_snowballs.name: Cold Sensitive
power.origins.damage_from_snowballs.desc: Your fiery nature makes cold deeply uncomfortable.
power.origins.nether_spawn.name: Nether Affinity
power.origins.nether_spawn.description: You deal 10% more damage and take 10% less in the Nether. After your first Nether visit, this doubles and applies everywhere.
power.origins.shulker_inventory.name: Hardened Shell
power.origins.shulker_inventory.descript: Your shell-like skin cushions your equipment. Durability loss on death is reduced.
power.origins.strong_arms.name: Strong Arms
power.origins.strong_arms.description: Your powerful arms mine blocks 20% faster.
power.origins.strong_arms_break_speed.de: Your strong arms let you mine 20% faster.
power.origins.nine_lives.name: Nine Lives
power.origins.nine_lives.description: Your feline agility comes at a cost: 20% less maximum health.
power.origins.throw_ender_pearl.name: Ender Shift
power.origins.throw_ender_pearl.descript: Teleport forward on a 60-second cooldown, or throw an ender pearl. After teleporting, deal 15% more damage for 10 seconds.
power.origins.fragile.name: Spectral Form
power.origins.fragile.description: Your half-phantom nature leaves you with only half the health of a normal being.
power.origins.hotblooded.name: Hotblooded
power.origins.hotblooded.description: Your blazing blood burns up venoms, making you immune to poison.
layer.origins.gender.name: Gender
origin.origins-plus-plus.demi_god.name: Demi-God
origin.origins-plus-plus.demi_god.descri: Scion of a forgotten god, the Demi-God towers over mortal limits with +40% health and the power to phase through matter. Divine Fury grants Strength on command. Raw meat sustains them doubly, cooked meat half again more. Fire burns them 50% hotter, and the Nether sickens their divine blood — but they endure.
origin.origins-plus-plus.ryu.name: Ryu
origin.origins-plus-plus.ryu.description: Dragon-blooded and ancient, the Ryu shrugs off 25% of all damage and heals rapidly from hearty meals. Broken wings grant slow fall rather than true flight. Their draconic stomach rejects anything that isn't meat, and healing potions are only half as potent on their scaled hide.
origin.origins-plus-plus.fallen_angel.de: A celestial being cast from grace, frail but devastatingly lethal. All attacks deal 15% bonus damage, though their broken body holds 20% less health. Tattered wings slow their descent, and they crave meat to fuel their war against creation. Fire sears them deeper than most.
origin.origins-plus-plus.kirin.name: Kirin
origin.origins-plus-plus.kirin.descripti: A mythical beast of impossible speed. Kirin scale walls like spiders, see in the dark, and sprint faster than any other race. Their lithe frames hold 20% less health, and the relentless pace of their movement burns through food quickly.
origin.origins-plus-plus.witch_of_ink.de: An artist who paints reality itself into being. Food provides half nourishment, but paintings sustain them. They paint with dyes, erase mistakes, and reanimate their art as allies. Frail and flammable, with 20% less health. Slaying bosses fuels their craft — 200 boss kills unlock the Blessing of Penthesilea.
origin.origins-plus-plus.artificial_cons: A golem forged from iron and bound by magic. Normal food provides only 25% nourishment — iron ingots and blocks are their true sustenance. Eating iron also accelerates natural healing by 400%. Consume enough iron to permanently upgrade their frame across five tiers, with the final two granting massive power spikes. Extended reach, natural armor, and reduced fall damage.
